description: Check availability (free/busy) for one or more people over a time range. Useful for finding open slots to schedule meetings.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

emails.description: Comma-separated email addresses to check availability for

time_max.description: End of the time range to check (ISO 8601)

time_min.description: Start of the time range to check (ISO 8601)

name: gws-mcp__calendar_freebusy
